# Setting responsive twice before its plugin has loaded adds two Responsive plugins

## Context

@neo-opus-vega spotted this by reading, as the twin of the `cellEditing` race @neo-gpt-emmy found in #18964, fixed by #18967. I measured it on 2026-09-19 at `dev@4802862b73`.

## The Problem

`component.Base#afterSetResponsive` checks `getPlugin('responsive')`, then awaits the plugin's `import()`, then appends a plugin config. Two `responsive` values set before that import settles both pass the check, so both continuations append.

Measured with a unit probe that shadows the instance's `plugins` config, so no plugin is built and only admission counts. `responsive = {small: {cls: ['a']}}` followed in the same tick by `responsive = {small: {cls: ['b']}}` assigns `plugins` **twice**, and the last assignment carries **two** Responsive entries. Each of those plugins wires its own viewport resize listener and applies the owner's `responsive` config on every resize. Measured again with real plugin instances: `neo-plugin-responsive-1` and `-2`.

**Found while fixing it: a component that turns `responsive` off throws on its next resize.** The plugin stays when `responsive` becomes `null`. Its `onResize` then runs `Object.entries(null)`: `Cannot convert undefined or null to object`, measured by calling `onResize` with a landscape rect after `responsive = null`. The premise below, one plugin serving every later value, holds only once `null` is a value that plugin serves too, so it is fixed here.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/component/Base.mjs#afterSetResponsive`: the lookup runs before `await me.trap(import('../../src/plugin/Responsive.mjs'))`.
- `src/plugin/Responsive.mjs#onResize` reads `owner.responsive` live, so one plugin serves every later value, and the plugin takes no value at creation. It is the plugin's only reader of `responsive`.
- #18967 settled the same shape in `grid.Container#afterSetCellEditing` by deciding admission once the import settles. A lookup made before the import cannot reserve the slot.

## The Fix

Decide admission once the import settles: after the `await`, a continuation that finds a Responsive plugin already present returns without appending. `onResize` returns early while `responsive` is off, so the plugin idles until the next value arrives.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Two `responsive` values set in one tick leave the component with one Responsive plugin. The arm is red on `dev`.
- [ ] A value set after the plugin exists adds none.
- [ ] With `responsive` turned off, a resize does not throw, and the next value is applied by the same plugin.
- [ ] The arms build real plugin instances, so `getPlugin()` is what they exercise, with the plugin's viewport wiring given a stand-in. They do not use the admission-count probe above, which cannot see `getPlugin()`.

## Out of Scope

- Turning `responsive` off does not remove the plugin; it idles. Removing it would be a separate decision.
- Other `afterSet*` hooks that import a plugin: a sweep of `getPlugin` + `import` in `afterSet` bodies belongs to a separate census if one is wanted.
